raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary

Link the installed test-recipe asset path to the source-test assets staged by GPU release validation.

## Why

The Muse Spark integration recipe is imported from the RC wheel and resolves its synthetic multimodal data below `site-packages/tests/assets`. GPU validation stages that data under its temporary source-test tree but does not connect the installed lookup path to it, so the test fails with `FileNotFoundError` before training starts.

This applies the same asset mapping already used by CPU release validation in #5606. It changes only the validation harness; loss goldens and model code are unchanged. The same setup is needed by the release GPU validation script on main.

Failure: https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/actions/runs/40066514161/job/120790868714

## Test plan

- `bash -n .github/scripts/validate_release_gpu.sh`
- `git diff --check`
- All available pre-commit hooks pass. Pyrefly could not run because the local environment does not provide the `pyrefly` executable; this PR changes only a shell script.

detail.title: [release/0.4][CI] Stage test assets for GPU validation

files.patch:
@@ -164,6 +164,19 @@ cp \
   "${REPO_ROOT}/torchtitan/experiments/graph_trainer/run_train_precompile.sh" \
   "${VALIDATION_ROOT}/torchtitan/experiments/graph_trainer/run_train_precompile.sh"
 
+# Installed test recipes resolve repository-local assets relative to
+# site-packages. Link that location to the staged source-test assets.
+SITE_PACKAGES="$(python - <<'PY'
+import sysconfig
+
+print(sysconfig.get_path("purelib"))
+PY
+)"
+mkdir -p "${SITE_PACKAGES}/tests/assets"
+ln -s \
+  "${VALIDATION_ROOT}/tests/assets/synthetic_multimodal" \
+  "${SITE_PACKAGES}/tests/assets/synthetic_multimodal"
+
 cd "${VALIDATION_ROOT}"
 unset PYTHONPATH
